Talent0_2Ability.name: Blazing Heart
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When equipped with a Missile Launcher, can use the Missile Launcher to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2</color>x DMG to the target, and Splash DMG equal to <color=#F74848>50%</color> of the primary damage to other parts, applying <buf ID=4008509>[Lock]</buf> to targets hit, lasting <color=#F74848>2</color> turns, up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Blazing Heart
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When equipped with a Missile Launcher, can use the Missile Launcher to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2</color>x DMG to the target, and Splash DMG equal to <color=#F74848>50%</color> of the primary damage to other parts, applying <buf ID=4008509>[Lock]</buf> to targets hit, lasting <color=#F74848>2</color> turns, up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn;
When both shoulders are equipped with Missile Launchers, <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> triggers <buf ID=900097>[Link Salvo]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>2×0.15</color>x DMG, and Splash DMG equal to <color=#F74848>50%</color> of the primary damage to other parts.

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

400803.name: Guided Bombardment
400803.describe:
Uses a Missile Launcher to attack up to <color=#F74848>2</color> targets, consuming up to <color=#F74848>2</color> Ammo, dealing <color=#F74848>0.9</color>x DMG to parts hit and Splash DMG equal to <color=#F74848>50%</color> of this damage to other parts.
Requires Missile Launchers to be mounted on both shoulders.

400804.name: Rapid Load
400804.describe: Fully reloads all Missile Launcher Ammo and gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. Can continue action with remaining Movement.

400805.name: Shell Swap
400805.describe: Switches between <buf ID=4008058>[Standard Mode]</buf> and <buf ID=4008051>[Precision Mode]</buf>.

400806.name: Focused Barrage
400806.describe: Uses a Missile Launcher to attack a single target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.4</color>x DMG and Splash DMG equal to <color=#F74848>50%</color> of this damage to other parts. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> before attacking. If the target is affected by <buf ID=4008509>[Lock]</buf>, enables all allies to launch <buf ID=900002>[Link Attacks]</buf> against it. These <buf ID=900002>[Link Attacks]</buf> do not require allies to possess a specific skill and do not consume any Link chances.

400807.name: Homemade Loader
400807.SpecificEffects: At the start of action, auto-loads <color=#F74848>1</color> Ammo into the non-exhausted Missile Launcher magazine with the lowest Ammo count.

400808.name: Full Salvo
400808.describe:
Fires all Missile Launcher Ammo, randomly attacking targets affected by <buf ID=4008509>[Lock]</buf>. Each missile deals <color=#F74848>0.65</color>x DMG to the part hit and Splash DMG equal to <color=#F74848>50%</color> of this damage to other parts. Each missile fired consumes <color=#F74848>1</color> AP, until Ammo is depleted or AP is exhausted. A single target can be attacked a maximum of <color=#F74848>5</color> times.
Requires Missile Launchers to be mounted on both shoulders.

400809.name: Targeted Bombardment
400809.describe: Uses a Missile Launcher to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.1</color>x DMG to the part hit and Splash DMG equal to <color=#F74848>50%</color> of this damage to other parts. Applies <buf ID=4008509>[Lock]</buf> to targets hit, lasting <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

400022.name: Power Innovation 2
400022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

400841.name: Proud Masterpiece 1
400841.SpecificEffects: Talent-triggered <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> chances per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

400844.name: Proud Masterpiece 2
400844.SpecificEffects: Each turn, the first ally to initiate an Active Attack can apply <buf ID=4008509>[Lock]</buf> to the target after their first active attack, lasting <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

400845.name: Proud Masterpiece 3
400845.SpecificEffects: When engaging in a talent-triggered <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, the damage multiplier increases by <color=#F74848>0.1</color>.

400846.name: Proud Masterpiece 4
400846.SpecificEffects: When performing a talent-triggered <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.
